# PLLM

Release: 0.1.0
Build: sha256:bab6f73b33765ac11862794abf645d4eb324a2fd52abc43cc2a9cd21c09e27c7

Private LLM inference documentation. Public weights; provider follows the protocol.

- [Build](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build.md)): Define a reproducible PLLM system from configuration, models, components, and research methods.
- [Models](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/model-adapters/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/model-adapters.md)): Turn model-family configuration into a shared decoder plan.
- [Conversions](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/conversions/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/conversions.md)): Learn how values move between numeric formats, layouts, and owners.
- [Gemma 4](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/gemma4/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/gemma4.md)): Variant-parameterized text-decoder lowering for exact Gemma 4 E2B and E4B configurations.
- [Models](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models.md)): See which model configurations PLLM can describe and what model support does not yet include.
- [Phi-4 mini](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/phi4-mini/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/phi4-mini.md)): Fused-projection and LongRoPE semantic lowering for Phi-4-mini-instruct.
- [Qwen2](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen2/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen2.md)): Dense Qwen2 semantic lowering and its present execution boundary.
- [Qwen3 and mini-coder](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen3/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen3.md)): Dense Qwen3 lowering with explicit head width and Q/K normalization.
- [Qwen3.5](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen35/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/models/qwen35.md)): Hybrid full-attention and gated-delta semantic lowering for Qwen3.5-4B.
- [Numerics](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/numerics/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/numerics.md)): Understand PLLM's integer arithmetic, quantization, rounding, approximation, and overflow checks.
- [SiLU activation](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/activation-silu/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/activation-silu.md)): Compile and evaluate PLLM's bounded experimental Q7 SiLU component.
- [Operators](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators.md)): Learn how PLLM describes model operations independently of model family and runtime.
- [Projection and rotary variants](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/projection-rotary/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/projection-rotary.md)): Represent fused projections, tensor slices, head widths, and rotary position rules.
- [Stateful recurrence](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/stateful-recurrence/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/operators/stateful-recurrence.md)): Represent convolution and recurrent state in a hybrid decoder plan.
- [Arithmetic garbling](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/arithmetic/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/arithmetic.md)): Mixed-modulus labels and projection gates over bounded arithmetic values.
- [Half-gates](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/half-gates/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/half-gates.md)): Boolean AND-gate representation and the obligations surrounding free-XOR circuit execution.
- [Garbling](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling.md)): Reference arithmetic and Boolean garbling components with explicit maturity and composition boundaries.
- [Lookup tables](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/lookup-tables/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/lookup-tables.md)): Bounded function tables with explicit domains, indexing, leakage, and material size.
- [Weighted path](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/weighted-path/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/garbling/weighted-path.md)): Decision-path representations for bounded piecewise or tree-structured secure evaluation.
- [Protocols](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols.md)): See how PLLM defines parties, messages, privacy assumptions, and failure behavior.
- [Masked linear](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/masked-linear/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/pipeline/protocols/masked-linear.md)): Prepared public-weight linear inference with seeded one-time masks and committed inventory.
- [Representations](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/representations/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/sdk/build/representations.md)): Understand how PLLM records a value's format, owner, bounds, and encoding.
